# youtrack_saved_query (Resource)

Manages a saved search. The search is owned by the user of the token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the saved search.
- `query` (String) Search query in YouTrack query syntax.

### Optional

- `updateable_by_group_id` (String) Database ID of the group that can edit the saved search.
- `visible_for_group_id` (String) Database ID of the group that can see the saved search.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the saved search.
